title: View Transitions API with HTML-in-canvas
blurb: A canvas that draws HTML inside startViewTransition(): which element can carry a name, a shader in place of the cross-fade, and a transition between two documents.
question: Does a canvas that draws HTML work with the View Transitions API, and can a shader replace the cross-fade?
result: A named canvas transitions as one live picture. A canvas child gets a group with no picture. Scoped transitions on the canvas or its children fail.
